events.name: Paranormal Tour at The Queen
events.info: With any historic theater comes unexplained noises, strange feelings, and unexpected apparitions... The Queen is no different. For those curious about the venue's history and inhabitants, we invite you to the first ever Paranormal Tour of The Queen! With help from the Cecil Paranormal Group as your guides, you'll get a private tour of The Queen - including areas typically reserved for employees - and use investigative equipment to answer the question for yourself: is The Queen haunted? Capacity is limited, so get your tickets today!
